svg.aria-label: Upper panel: the Kelvin-Helmholtz growth rate as a fraction of its field-free value, against the magnetic field component along the wavevector. The curve is a quarter circle falling to zero at 0.0675 gauss. Lower panel: the same bound expressed as an angle. For a total field of ten gauss the wavevector must lie within four tenths of a degree of perpendicular to the field.
